advisories.title: Existing immediate edge-count assertion races asynchronous graph layout
advisories.evidence: Independent full candidate rerun was 57 passed and 1 failed at C06 WebKit (2 edges immediately observed, expected 3). Focused candidate repeats: 1 passed / 4 failed; unchanged 90382f baseline under identical browser, viewport and fixture: also 1 passed / 4 failed. Independent bounded waiting assertion found all 3 edges without further action, stable afterwards, in all 10 candidate repeats across Chromium/WebKit and all 5 baseline WebKit repeats.
advisories.classification: Existing assertion timing sensitivity; not a new persistent graph regression. Original failing evidence retained, not relabeled as a 58/58 pass.
advisories.followup: Use an auto-retrying locator count assertion in a separately reviewed test update; this frozen candidate was not edited.

independent_verification.independent_gate_probe: Both browsers reject cached records outside current catalog or historical as_of, cached oversize reads and aborted reads, plus invalid data paths. Exact reference association succeeds; ID fragments, nested objects and future_child proposals do not associate. Run/evidence map to plan, decision to feedback, review does not become supplemental content.
independent_verification.risk_review: Lookup reads only selected validated catalog membership, sequentially at most 10 objects each bounded to 1000000 streamed bytes. Content-address verification precedes caching; cache hits recheck membership, size, abort and historical time. Failure entries remain explicitly unknown. A snapshot/round/tab key remount cancels scanning, and live/ref checks suppress stale async updates. New source does not mutate graph data or infer successor edges. Full panel opens only after explicit selection.
independent_verification.real_navigation_graph_viewport_selection: PASS both browsers; real records open through proper plan/feedback tabs without changing graph count, viewport or selected round
independent_verification.visual_result: Readable drawer records and disclosed reference fields; plan tab shows run/evidence, feedback tab shows decisions and proposed-next-step limitations. Existing three-tab layout retained. No executed-child or trial-start claim introduced.
independent_verification.history_refresh_failure_cancel_size_hash: Passed applicable existing and new browser cases; old snapshot restrictions retained.
